key.name: show-in-panel
key.summary: Show lyrics in GNOME Top Bar
key.description: Display the active line of Spotify lyrics directly inside the GNOME Shell Top Bar panel.

key.name: panel-show-artist
key.summary: Show artist in the top bar

key.name: panel-show-title
key.summary: Show song title in the top bar

key.name: floating-line-count
key.description: Two lines place the active lyric first. Three or more place it second, with one previous line above it. The first lyric starts in the first row.

key.name: show-countdown
key.summary: Show countdown dots before the next lyric

key.name: show-floating
key.description: Render a persistent floating lyrics overlay directly on the desktop.

key.name: floating-always-on-top
key.description: Keep the floating desktop lyrics overlay above all standard application windows.

key.name: floating-click-passthrough
key.description: Disable pointer events on the floating overlay so mouse clicks pass through to windows beneath.

key.name: floating-moving
key.description: Set by the Move button in the preferences. Accepts the pointer and outlines the lyrics until Done is pressed, without changing click-through.

key.name: floating-position
key.description: Screen corner preset or custom coordinate mode for the floating overlay.

key.name: lyrics-alignment
key.description: Align text left, center, right, or follow vocalist positions from the source. Without vocalist positions, use center alignment.

key.name: floating-x
key.description: Horizontal pixel coordinate of the floating HUD when position is set to custom.

key.name: floating-y
key.description: Vertical pixel coordinate of the floating HUD when position is set to custom.

key.name: font-family
key.description: Font family for rendering synced lyrics in the floating HUD.

key.name: font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for the active line in the floating overlay.

key.name: line-spacing
key.description: Vertical spacing in pixels between lyric lines in the floating overlay.

key.name: background-style
key.description: Background visual style for the floating HUD: transparent, blurred glass, or dark pill card.

key.name: enable-spicy-lyrics
key.description: Fetch enhanced syllable-synced lyrics from Spicy Lyrics API when available.

key.name: spicy-lyrics-client-key
key.description: User-provided client key for fetching word-timed lyrics.

key.name: animate-lyrics
key.summary: Animate lyrics when word timing is available
key.description: Use character highlighting with timed words or syllables. Line-timed lyrics always use the normal display. Turn off for normal lyrics from every source.

key.name: enable-romanization
key.description: Automatically transliterate Korean (Hangul), Japanese (Kana), and Cyrillic lyrics to Latin characters.

key.name: player-layout
key.description: Compact places playback controls below song details; Horizontal places them beside the details.

key.name: player-scale
key.summary: Overall player size as a percentage

key.name: player-lyric-lines
key.summary: Number of visible lines in the horizontal player

key.name: spotify-client-id
key.description: Client ID of the user's own Spotify app, used to like songs from the player.

key.name: spotify-refresh-token
key.description: Issued when the Spotify account is connected. Cleared by disconnecting.

key.name: player-pinned
key.summary: Keep the player visible on the desktop
key.description: Show a draggable player independently of the floating lyrics.
